summary: Comprehensive bug fix testing for iteration 22. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified: SaaS plan editing with boolean preservation, class create/edit/delete with date ranges, members 'Ver' contact button, attendance modal scroll, staff gym selector for super admin, light/dark mode toggle. Demo button confirmed removed from login page.
